reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: Dockerfile runs s6-overlay with 2 long-running services (dashboard, main-hermes) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile uses s6-overlay to supervise the main hermes process and the dashboard in one container, and no shown line proves the dashboard is optional in production.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /opt/data (Dockerfile), volume ~/.hermes:/opt/data (docker-compose.yml gateway), volume ~/.hermes:/opt/data (docker-compose.yml dashboard)
reviews.reason: The image keeps its writable state under /opt/data, which includes config, sessions and SQLite-backed memory, and no shown setting moves that data to a managed database or S3.
